record.field:
Search for documents in Odoo's Documents app. Returns a list of matching documents with their ID, name, folder, type, size, and owner.
Use this to find documents before reading them with the Read Document tool. You can search by name, folder name, or file type (mimetype).
Returns CSV with pipe (|) delimiter: ``` id|name|folder|mimetype|size|owner|create_date 42|Invoice Q1.pdf|Finance|application/pdf|245000|John|2026-01-15 ```

doc = env['documents.document'].browse(document_id) if not doc.exists(): ai['result'] = f"Document {document_id} not found" else: attachment = doc.attachment_id base_url = env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param('web.base.url') tokens = attachment.generate_access_token() url = f"{base_url}/web/content/{attachment.id}?access_token={tokens[0]}" info = { 'id': doc.id, 'name': doc.name, 'folder': doc.folder_id.name or '', 'mimetype': doc.mimetype or '', 'size': doc.file_size or 0, 'url': url, 'description': doc.description or '', 'tags': ', '.join(doc.tag_ids.mapped('name')) if doc.tag_ids else '', 'owner': doc.owner_id.name or '', 'create_date': str(doc.create_date), } import json ai['result'] = json.dumps(info)

Read details and get the download URL for a specific document from Odoo's Documents app. Returns document metadata including a direct download URL with access token.
The URL can be used to download the file directly. When code execution is enabled, you can fetch the URL and analyze the file content (Excel, CSV, PDF, etc.).
Parameters: - document_id: The numeric ID of the document (from Search Documents results)
Returns JSON: ```json { "id": 42, "name": "Invoice Q1.pdf", "folder": "Finance", "mimetype": "application/pdf", "size": 245000, "url": "https://example.odoo.com/web/content/123?access_token=abc...", "description": "", "tags": "invoice, Q1", "owner": "John", "create_date": "2026-01-15 10:30:00" } ```
